modes.title: My Story Path
modes.skill: order baby, toddler, and now from earlier to later

modes.title: Family Map
modes.skill: connect family story prompts with places on a world map

voice.welcome: Welcome to your family storybook. Make your growing story, then follow family stars around the world.
voice.timeline-intro: The memories got mixed up. Put baby, toddler, and now in order.
voice.timeline-help: Pick up a memory, then find where it belongs.
voice.try-again: That memory belongs in a different time. Try another pocket.
voice.now-placed: Now comes last. Look how you've grown!
voice.map-intro: Spin the paper globe to the glowing family star.
voice.spin-help: Swipe the globe, or tap the big spin button.
voice.landed: You found a family story place!
voice.choose-stamp: Choose a family story to tuck into your book.
voice.food-prompt: What food does your family love to share?
voice.place-prompt: What place does your family remember?
voice.celebration-prompt: How does your family celebrate together?
voice.stamp-earned: That story belongs in your family book.
voice.map-complete: Three family stars! Your story reaches around the world.
voice.book-intro: Here is your family storybook. Every family story is special.
voice.photo-privacy: A grown-up can choose a photo. It stays only on this device.
voice.photo-added: Your photo is tucked safely into the book.
voice.photo-failed: That photo did not fit. Your illustrated memory is still here.
voice.remove-photo: Remove this photo from this device?
voice.photo-removed: The photo is gone from this device.
voice.timeline-nudge: Try baby first, then toddler, then now.
voice.map-nudge: Turn the globe toward the glowing star.
